title: Page 2
content_zh:
不会吧？这么准，才刚想到的人马上就出现在眼前，只是，刚刚想了老半天才终于鼓起的勇气，在看见他之后竟一下子逃逸无踪。
“嗨……”她紧张的撑起一个微笑。“你、你好。”
男人走向她，站在她面前，将近一百九的身高让她得仰起头才看得见他的脸，更别说那一身结实的肌肉带来的恐怖压迫感。乔若曦的呼吸都不顺畅了起来。
“今、今天只有你一个人来啊？”她两手用力交握，避免自己颤抖的太厉害。
“嗯。”高大沉默的男人似乎也不知道该说什么，严肃的点了点头。
“呃……要吃点什么吗？晚餐吃过了吗？今天的特餐是欧式香草烤鸡腿，你要吃吃看吗？”她很紧张焦虑，所以讲话又急又快，其实她也知道这不是她想讲的，可是真正想讲的话——她根本就没有勇气开口！
“好。”
男人的回答只有单音，可是听在乔若曦耳里却像是特赦，她很高兴现在可以有别的事情做，而不用面对他。
“那我去弄。请、请先找个位子坐，等一下。”说完她迅速躲进厨房。
她刻意拖延了很多时间。其实饭菜都处理好了，只要盛盘就可以上菜，可是她却用了快要二十分钟才硬着头皮从厨房里走出来。
当她看见男人一改常态，不是坐在窗边而是坐在吧台前的位置，她的身子抖了一下，餐盘里的汤也溢出来一些。他看着她的视线就像两道雷射光，彷佛可以把她穿透一般。
“请用。”
将菜端上桌后，她低着头，只敢看着桌面，不敢看男人。
突然，她死盯着的桌面上出现男人的手，以及一张名片。
她惶恐的用双手接过。
天阔集团
名片上只写了这几个字，还有电话跟手机号码，但从公司名称根本看不出来经营的是什么事业。
乔若曦只想到两个可能：一个是根本不用写人家就应该知道的公司；二是他所经营的事业内容是不适合写在名片上的。
困难的吞了口口水，她觉得口干舌燥起来。
“褚、褚先生。”

他突然伸手抓住她的小手，她差点尖叫出声，惊惧的看他，像是小白兔看见大黑熊般恐惧的眼神。
“你可以……咳，叫我天阔。”
那张黝黑、棱角分明的脸上出现一抹不自在的神色，看得乔若曦一阵慌乱。
她又想哭了，一股很强烈的冲动让她想要现在就跟他自首。
“对、对不起……”我错了！那天想要告白的对象其实是你朋友，不是你！我没有喜欢你，我也没有那个胆喜欢你，事实上，我只要在你身边就觉得压力好大，好害怕——
她正想要一古脑的把话说出来，这时门口传来声响。
“老板娘，送货来了。”
她不知道该感谢还是埋怨送货的在这时候打扰，不过刚要讲的话肯定是没办法继续了。
“抱歉，我去一下。”
每个星期她会进货一次，店里的咖啡豆、果汁、牛奶等东西都由食品公司统一送达。她的店位在小巷里，送货员每次都急着把车开走，签收了以后，就会把东西摆在店门口，没空帮她搬。
那些东西大都很重，所以她得把箱子拆开，分批搬进店里。
她叹了口气，正要弯下腰的时候——
箱子自动升起来了。
乔若曦一点力气也没出，箱子就整个从地上移到她店里。
“呃，不、不好意思。你不用……”
褚天阔没有理会她惶恐的声音，擅自就把东西给搬进厨房。对他而言，替女人搬东西是天经地义的事情，尤其现在他跟她的关系又“非比寻常”。
那张百年冰封的冷酷脸孔，在听到她的声音时，出现了一种如果他的属下或是生意上的敌手看到，绝对会吓破胆的温柔表情。
走进厨房后，他停下来，用眼神询问。
“放、放在那边的地上就可以了。”
厨房本来就小，挤进了高大的褚天阔之后连转身的空间都没有了。

他把东西放下后随即出了厨房，让乔若曦松了口气，她蹲下来从箱子里拿出五公升的果汁要放进冰箱里。
她想起刚刚他拎起箱子的样子彷佛里面装的只是棉花，她的脸色又苍白了不少……
整理完那些食材，乔若曦走出厨房，看到褚天阔已经把盘里的食物都扫光了，眼睛正炯炯有神的看着她，一点都不像有要离开的意思。
她虚弱的扯起一个微笑。“吃完了？还合你的口味吗？”
他点头，不善言词的他从来没有像此刻一样，希望自己能拥有跟好友一样的好口才，可以跟她说他一直很喜欢她的手艺。
“呃，我有话想跟你说。”
他挑眉。
这次她一定要说。她告诉自己，不管他瞪着她的样子有多恐怖，她都必须开口把该讲清楚的话讲出来。
“其实——”
“老大！”咖啡屋的门突然被大力推开，几个穿着黑衣的壮硕男子闯进来，冲到褚天阔身边。
男人们散发出凶恶的气息，被这番阵仗吓坏了的乔若曦只能呆立在一旁。
“什么事？我不是说今天晚上别来打扰我？”
褚天阔只不过是眉一皱，整个人就散发出强烈的压迫感，那些壮汉在他面前个个都变得温顺卑微。
“老大，对不起，是因为突然有急事。”其中一个人在他耳边说了些话，他沉下脸，原本就威严的面孔显得更加令人畏惧。
“知道了，你们去外面等我。”
“是。”
褚天阔只轻轻一扬手，那群黑衣人就迅速消失在门外。
“对不起，我得走了。”
她眨了眨眼，片刻才会意过来他是在跟她讲话。
她没听错吧？他跟她说……对不起？

“不、不！没、没关系！”她猛摇手，像是怕他不相信似的。“呃，你有事的话就去忙吧！”
好可怕！她现在只想远离这个男人！
褚天阔把一张千元大钞放在桌上，起身就要离去。
乔若曦看到了连忙回过神来叫他，“等等，我要找你钱呢！”
但他却没听见，她赶紧冲出店门追上他，谁知他一转身，她的鼻子就撞上他硬梆梆的胸膛，意料之外的冲击让她愣愣的仰起头。
褚天阔低头看着她，她注意到他有一双浓黑的眉，还有双深幽的眼睛……她过去一直不敢对上他的视线，没想到现在看来……感觉其实也不是太可怕。
下一秒，她的视线突然模糊了，眼前的男性脸庞突然放大，然后她感觉额头暖暖的，身体被圈进一个散发着好闻味道的怀抱里。
被……抱了？还被亲了？
她整个石化。
“不用找钱了。我们的关系……咳，以后可以不用算那么清楚。”
他走了很久以后乔若曦都还不能动弹。
她的手摸了摸自己的额头，不敢相信那里曾被吻过。
我们的关系……以后可以不用算的那么清楚……
突然想到他在她耳边说的那句话，她哀号了一声。
怎么办啊？事情越来越不可收拾了。
第1章(2)
乔若曦紧张的坐在店里。从昨天接到褚天阔的电话“指示”说今天要空出时间来跟他约会，她就胃部打结，睡也睡不好，脑袋里拚命告诉自己要趁这个机会跟他说清楚，可是心里又好害怕。
开门的声音传来，她抬起头，褚天阔已经走进店门了。
她紧张的挤出一个虚弱的微笑。“你好……你真准时……”

“可以走了？”
content_en:
No way? It was so accurate that the person he had just thought of appeared in front of him immediately. However, the courage he finally mustered up after thinking about it for a long time suddenly ran away without a trace after seeing him.
"Hi..." She smiled nervously. "H-hello."
The man walked towards her and stood in front of her. His height of nearly 190 made her have to raise her head to see his face, not to mention the terrifying pressure caused by his strong muscles. Qiao Ruoxi's breathing became uneasy.
"Today, are you the only one here today?" She clasped her hands tightly to prevent herself from shaking too much.
"Yeah." The tall and silent man seemed not to know what to say and nodded seriously.
"Um... do you want something to eat? Have you had dinner? Today's special is European-style herb roasted chicken legs. Do you want to eat it?" She was very nervous and anxious, so she spoke quickly and quickly. In fact, she also knew that this was not what she wanted to say, but what she really wanted to say - she didn't have the courage to speak at all!
"Okay."
The man's answer was only a single tone, but it sounded like a pardon to Qiao Ruoxi's ears. She was happy that she could have other things to do now instead of facing him.
"Then I'll do it. Please, please find a seat and wait a moment." After that, she quickly hid in the kitchen.
She deliberately delayed a lot of time. In fact, the food was all taken care of and it was ready to be served, but it took her nearly twenty minutes to bravely walk out of the kitchen.
When she saw that the man changed from his usual position and sat in front of the bar instead of by the window, her body trembled and some of the soup on the plate spilled out. The way he looked at her was like two laser beams, as if they could penetrate her.
"Please use it."
After putting the dishes on the table, she lowered her head and only dared to look at the table, not daring to look at the man.
Suddenly, a man's hand and a business card appeared on the table she was staring at.
She panicked and took it with both hands.
Tiankuo Group
The business card only contains these words, as well as a phone number and mobile phone number, but it is impossible to tell what kind of business it is running from the company name.
Qiao Ruoxi only thinks of two possibilities: one is that people should know the company without writing it down at all; the other is that the business content he runs is not suitable to be written on a business card.
She swallowed hard, her mouth felt dry.
"Chu, Mr. Chu."
He suddenly reached out and grabbed her little hand, and she almost screamed, looking at him in fear, like a little white rabbit looking at a big black bear.
"You can... cough, call me Tiankuo."
There was an uncomfortable look on that dark, angular face, which made Qiao Ruoxi panic.
She wanted to cry again, and a strong impulse made her want to surrender to him now.
"Yes, I'm sorry..." I was wrong! The person you want to confess to that day is actually your friend, not you! I don’t like you, and I don’t have the guts to like you. In fact, whenever I’m around you, I feel so stressed and scared——
She was just about to say what she wanted to say, when there was a sound at the door.
"Lady boss, the delivery is here."
She didn't know whether to thank or blame the delivery man for interrupting at this time, but she definitely couldn't continue what she was about to say.
"Sorry, I have to go."
She will purchase goods once a week, and the coffee beans, juice, milk and other items in the store are all delivered by food companies. Her store is in an alley, and the deliveryman is always in a hurry to drive away. After signing for the goods, he will place the items at the door of the store and has no time to help her move them.
Most of the items were heavy, so she had to unpack them and move them into the store in batches.
She sighed and was about to bend down——
The box rose automatically.
Qiao Ruoxi didn't exert any strength at all, and the whole box was moved from the ground to her store.
"Uh, no, sorry. You don't have to..."
Chu Tiankuo ignored her terrified voice.Yin, he moved things into the kitchen without permission. For him, moving things for a woman is a matter of course, especially now that his relationship with her is "unusual."
When he heard her voice, the cold face that had been frozen for a hundred years showed a gentle expression that would definitely frighten his subordinates or business rivals if they saw it.
After entering the kitchen, he stopped and asked with his eyes.
"Just put it on the ground over there."
The kitchen was already small, and after squeezing in the tall Chu Tiankuo, there was no room to even turn around.
After he put down the things, he immediately left the kitchen. Qiao Ruoxi breathed a sigh of relief. She squatted down and took out five liters of juice from the box to put in the refrigerator.
She remembered how he had just picked up the box as if it was just cotton, and her face turned a lot pale...
After sorting out the ingredients, Qiao Ruoxi walked out of the kitchen and saw that Chu Tiankuo had swept away all the food on the plate and was looking at her with bright eyes, without any intention of leaving.
She smiled weakly. "Have you finished eating? Does it still suit your taste?"
He nodded. He was not good at words and he had never been more eloquent than at this moment. He hoped that he could have the same good eloquence as his best friend and could tell her that he had always liked her craftsmanship.
"Uh, I have something to tell you."
He raised an eyebrow.
She must say it this time. She told herself that no matter how scary he looked at her, she had to speak out and say what she needed to say clearly.
"Actually -"
"Boss!" The door of the coffee house was suddenly pushed open with great force, and several sturdy men in black broke in and rushed to Chu Tiankuo's side.
The men exuded a vicious aura, and Qiao Ruoxi, who was frightened by the battle, could only stand aside.
"What's the matter? Didn't I say don't disturb me tonight?"
Chu Tiankuo just frowned, and his whole body exuded a strong sense of oppression, and all the strong men became docile and humble in front of him.
"Boss, I'm sorry, it's because of a sudden emergency." One of the people said something in his ear, and his face darkened, making his already majestic face look even more intimidating.
"I know, you go wait for me outside."
"Yes."
Chu Tiankuo only raised his hand slightly, and the group of men in black quickly disappeared outside the door.
"Sorry, I have to go."
She blinked, and it took her a moment to realize that he was talking to her.
Did she hear it correctly? He told her...I'm sorry?
"No, no! No, it doesn't matter!" She shook her hand violently, as if she was afraid that he wouldn't believe it. "Well, if you have something to do, go ahead and do it!"
How terrible! She just wants to stay away from this man now!
Chu Tiankuo put a thousand-yuan bill on the table, stood up and was about to leave.
Qiao Ruoxi saw it and quickly came to her senses and called him, "Wait a minute, I want to ask you for money!"
But he didn't hear her. She rushed out of the store to catch up with him. Unexpectedly, as soon as he turned around, her nose bumped into his hard chest. The unexpected impact made her raise her head.
Chu Tiankuo looked down at her, and she noticed that he had thick black eyebrows and deep eyes... She had never dared to meet his gaze in the past, but she didn't expect that now... it didn't feel too scary.
The next second, her vision suddenly blurred, and the male face in front of her suddenly enlarged. Then she felt warmth on her forehead, and her body was enveloped in an embrace that smelled good.
Being hugged by...? Got kissed?
She was petrified.
"No need to change. Our relationship... well, you don't need to calculate it so clearly in the future."
Qiao Ruoxi couldn't move even after he left for a long time.
She touched her forehead with her hand, unable to believe that she had been kissed there.
Our relationship... we don’t need to calculate it so clearly in the future...
Suddenly thinking of what he said in her ear, she wailed.
What should I do? Things are getting more and more unbearableLost it.
Chapter 1(2)
Qiao Ruoxi sat nervously in the store. Ever since she received the "instruction" from Chu Tiankuo on the phone yesterday that she would make time to go on a date with him today, her stomach was in knots and she couldn't sleep well. She desperately told herself to take this opportunity to tell him clearly, but she was so scared in her heart.
The sound of the door opening came and she raised her head. Chu Tiankuo had already walked into the store.
She forced a weak smile nervously. "Hello...you are so punctual..."
